title: Claude-guided agentic design yields antibody candidates that remove receptor-bound IgE
summary: A research team guided an agentic computational design campaign with Claude toward a biparatopic antibody that removes IgE from its receptor FcepsilonRI. Of 91 experimentally characterized disruptor designs, 20 were active against receptor-bound IgE in bio-layer interferometry, and three variants removed more IgE than omalizumab at 25-400 nM. De novo anchor arms bound IgE with apparent affinities of 3.4-235 nM. These are early subcomponents, not a final drug, and the abstract alone was reviewed.
